name: Leia Organa's space cruiser
description: This small space cruiser was used by the Rebel Alliance for general transportation. Princess Leia Organa used this cruiser to leave Yavin 4 in search of Luke Skywalker, who had gone missing while searching for a new location for the Rebel base and was eventually captured by Crimson Jack before she could find him. The vessel required a single pilot to be operated.
